title: Zephyrine and the Prom
author: Yara Ashgrove
blurb: Freya Pemberton, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
